message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src-vul/htslib/sam.c", "function": "bam_read1", "line": 564, "var": "c->l_qname", "code": "c->l_qname = x[2]&0xff;", "note": "l_qname is read from the BAM core data as a 1-byte field"},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src-vul/htslib/sam.c", "function": "bam_read1", "line": 565, "var": "c->l_extranul", "code": "c->l_extranul = (c->l_qname%4 != 0)? (4 - c->l_qname%4) : 0;", "note": "l_extranul is 0 when l_qname is a multiple of 4, so no NUL padding bytes are added"},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src-vul/htslib/sam.c", "function": "bam_read1", "line": 578, "var": "b->data", "code": "bgzf_read(fp, b->data, c->l_qname)", "note": "l_qname bytes of qname data are read into b->data; no NUL terminator is guaranteed"},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src-vul/htslib/sam.c", "function": "bam_read1", "line": 579, "var": "b->data[c->l_qname+i]", "code": "for (i = 0; i < c->l_extranul; ++i) b->data[c->l_qname+i] = '\\0';", "note": "When l_extranul is 0, no NUL bytes are appended after the qname"},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src-vul/htslib/sam.c", "function": "bam_read1", "line": 596, "var": "bam_get_qname(b)", "code": "hts_log_error(\"CIGAR and query sequence lengths differ for %s\", bam_get_qname(b));", "note": "bam_get_qname(b) returns (char*)b->data; with no NUL terminator, %s reads past the allocated buffer into adjacent memory, causing a heap-buffer-overflow"},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src-vul/htslib/sam.c", "function": "bam_read1", "line": 596, "var": "bam_get_qname(b)", "code": "hts_log_error(\"CIGAR and query sequence lengths differ for %s\", bam_get_qname(b));", "note": "The CIGAR length (0x1010101) does not match l_qseq (1), triggering the error path that uses %s with the non-NUL-terminated qname"}
]
EOF
echo "Trace written"` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
